explanation: Exchanging business cards is standard practice in German business culture, typically done at the start of a meeting after a formal introduction with a firm handshake. Cards are not handed out as freely as in the U.S.; giving one signals permission to make future contact, so treat collected cards as confidential. Receive a card with a brief look of respect before putting it away carefully.
local_tip: Offer your card with your right hand (or both hands) at the initial introduction, and take a moment to read any card you receive before pocketing it.

also_check.note: Less formal exchange, but a brief respectful acknowledgment of the card is customary.
Relaxed but respectful; cards are exchanged casually during or after the initial conversation.
Acceptable to exchange cards after a conversation rather than at the formal introduction.
